title: Cure Payment Amount — Collections Desk Figure Sheet
content:
**Amount.** On Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts, a cure payment is the one-time scheduled-installment payment a borrower makes from their own bank account to bring the installments of a contract that are past their grace period up to date. The cure payment is the monthly payment for each installment it brings current plus the fees due on the contract, rounded to the cent.

**Installments brought current.** They are counted from the days the oldest unpaid installment is past due, in calendar days from the next due date to the payment date: when those days exceed the tier's grace days, the payment brings current one installment plus one more for each full 30 days in the days past due beyond the grace days and the day after them; otherwise it brings none current. The tier's grace days are 10 at every tier.

**Application.** The payment is applied to the interest accrued since the last payment date, then to the fees due, then to principal, and it moves the next due date one month later for each installment it brings current, never beyond the maturity date.

## Installments brought current (grace days 10)

| Days past due on the payment date | Days beyond the grace days and the day after them | Full 30-day blocks | Installments brought current |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 | not beyond grace | — | none |
| 11 | 0 | 0 | 1 |
| 40 | 29 | 0 | 1 |
| 41 | 30 | 1 | 2 |
| 70 | 59 | 1 | 2 |
| 71 | 60 | 2 | 3 |

## Worked figure (hypothetical contract)

Monthly payment 420.00, next due date 2026-02-05, payment date 2026-03-22, fees due 30.00:

1. Days past due: 2026-02-05 to 2026-03-22, 45 days.
2. Beyond the 10 grace days and the day after them: 34 days, one full 30-day block, so 2 installments are brought current.
3. Cure payment: 420.00 times 2, plus 30.00, that is 870.00.
4. The next due date moves two months, from 2026-02-05 to 2026-04-05, unless that would pass the maturity date.
